title: Hanasato Minori — I'm Gonna Lose My Head!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Screaming?! Welcome to the Forest of Wolves!

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So... We managed to make all the parts for our wolf yesterday, so let's put the finishing touches on them today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We just need to attach the helmet to the long, thin cardboard mouth...

rows.Speaker: Costume Team Member A
rows.Line: Can we try draping the cloth we made over it too, Minori? We sorta need to see if it's the right size.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sure. Oh, while we're at it, let's make sure the mouth attaches to the helmet at the right angle!

rows.Speaker: Costume Team Member B
rows.Line: Okay! Alright, first, we need to see if this covers the entire head...

rows.Speaker: Costume Team Member A
rows.Line:
Nice! It fits just right!
But the mouth... Maybe we should tilt it down a bit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Um... How's this?

rows.Speaker: Costume Team Member B
rows.Line:
Wait, that's too low!
Can you move it back a little?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Uh, just a little bit...
How about now?!

rows.Speaker: Costume Team Member A
rows.Line:
Perfect!
Just hold it right there as we drape the cloth over it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone!
The teacher brought cookies for us!

rows.Speaker: Costume Team Member A
rows.Line: Awesome! Way to go, Teach!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I was just starting to get kinda hungry!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. We each should get three, so take whichever ones you like.

rows.Speaker: Costume Team Member A
rows.Line: Thanks! Let's dig in!

rows.Speaker: Costume Team Member B
rows.Line: Mmm... These are delicious! And baked to a perfect crisp!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: U-Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Minori? Aren't you gonna have some?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-As much as I want to...

rows.Speaker: Costume Team Member A
rows.Line: Oh no! We asked you to hold the helmet and mouth together! That totally slipped my mind!

rows.Speaker: Costume Team Member A
rows.Line:
We can glue it together now and... Huh?
Where'd the glue go?

rows.Speaker: Costume Team Member B
rows.Line:
I think I lent it to the props team!
Lemme go ask them!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
These yummy-looking cookies are sitting right in front of me... But I can't have any of them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Want me to take your place?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You'd do that?! Wait, but...we have it just the way we want it right now, so it might move if we try to swap places.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right...
Then, we'll feed you. Open wide.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're a genius! Let's do that!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hehe. You're like a fish during feeding time...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shiho! Why are you laughing?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because you're making such a weird face. Anyway, which do you want?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?! Shiho, you're gonna feed me?!
Oh no...! Won't Shizuku get mad at me?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What does she have to do with this?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But if you're gonna make it hard for us... Let's go, Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, Shiho, wait!
I want to have some cookies!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Fine...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. You get three cookies, Minori.
Which would you like?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'd like... Oh, the one on the very right with chocolate on it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This one? Okay, here you go.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Aaahhh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You don't have to open that wide...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You're like a hungry wolf.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, yeah! If only opening my mouth meant cookies would magically fly into it. Rawr...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What was that? That wasn't very wolflike, so take two.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Try to imagine being really hungry...
You've got to look like you're famished or no cookie.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Shiho, that's mean!
